newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index up, trade firms in week.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index up, trade firms in week.

text.p: Kuwait Stock Exchange's (KSE) index rose 34.7 points to 2,399.2 during the week to Wednesday in firmer trade volumes compared to the previous week, figures released on Thursday show.
Daily average for value of traded shares rose to 61.6 million dinars from 27.8 million. Volume rose to a daily average of 198.8 million shares from 155.8 million.
Gainers led losers 28-22, while 16 shares did not move.
Investment firms were the most active in terms of traded value with 126.2 million dinars, followed by property firms with 82.5 million and industrials with 34.5 million.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
